title: sec filing / 8 k / regional bank | COMMUNITY TRUST BANCORP INC /KY/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Community Trust Bancorp Inc, a small regional bank holding company headquartered in Pikeville, Kentucky, filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026, announcing financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes an earnings press release as Exhibit 99.1 but does not disclose specific financial figures in the 8-K itself.
